title: Stone Ore
description: Give the stone of the stone ore you're mining!
body:
Ever wonder where all that stone goes when you mine an iron ore block? It always seemed strange that the ore drops, but the surrounding stone simply vanishes.

Don't worry anymore! With this mod, every time you break a stone-based ore, you'll receive both the ore itself and the corresponding cobblestone, ensuring no stone is mysteriously lost during your mining adventures.
